intent: generate a new high-definition pose from selected A reference

direct_inputs.role: principal identity/proportions/color/outline/paper-watercolor reference; new drawing, not an edit target
acting/cup position/eyelid intention reference ONLY; not style, line weight or resolution reference

tool_request.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one production character key-pose PNG, not a pose sheet.
Primary request: draw ONE new, high-definition full-body pose from scratch, using reference Image 1 as the principal original artwork. Do not upscale, trace, filter or reuse the low-resolution pixels of Image 2.
Input roles: Image 1 (selected A edit-v002 bear) is the strict identity, proportions, color, medium-brown outline weight and watercolor/paper-texture reference. Image 2 is ONLY an acting/pose and prop-position guide. Do NOT copy Image 2's old thick outlines, smaller rendering, facial restyling or resolution.
Subject invariants: exactly the same pale warm-yellow bear with a large wide head, short rounded torso and short feet, rounded ears and coral-red beret with its curved brim and top tab. Preserve the characteristic white elongated eye surrounds and vertical brown oval pupils whenever eyes are open, the small brown nose, independent inverted-U outer mouth arch, curled smiling mouth and pink tongue when visible. No added eye highlights, eyebrows, blush, teeth or clothes.
Style: match Image 1's soft warm cream/yellow watercolor fill, coral red, warm brown lines and delicate irregular paper grain. Medium outer contour approximately 13.5 native pixels on a 1254px image (5.24px when the standing reference height is 430px), with distinctly finer facial/internal lines, exactly the weight balance of Image 1. Do not revert to the heavy contours of Image 2 or make a thin vector outline.
Framing and calibration: request a 1254 x 1254 square transparent canvas. Keep the complete figure and every extremity inside it. Keep the same physical size as Image 1: standing calibration height 1107 native pixels, standing hat top around y=77, anatomical foot baseline y=1184, central support x=622.5. The head width is approximately 695 pixels and must remain the same physical width across poses. Maintain fixed character scale and stable soles; a bent pose may occupy less vertical height and must NOT be enlarged to fill the canvas.
Acting for tea_sip: reproduce Image 2's actual sipping stage. Stand with both feet planted; both paws bring the SAME plain cream teacup to the mouth so the cup naturally covers the lower mouth. BOTH EYES ARE CLOSED as two gentle happy curved eyelid strokes, as in Image 2; do not add open pupils, extra eyelashes or extra eyes. Preserve the A bear's face identity under this intentional closed-eye expression. Keep the cup's position, angle, relative size and paw grip from Image 2. The hidden tongue must not be redrawn outside the cup. No saucer, table or steam.
Background/output: genuine transparent alpha outside the painted bear (and the one cup in tea poses). Preserve clean soft painted edges. No opaque background, no checkerboard drawing, no ground shadow, no extra limbs, no extra props, no border, no lettering or watermark. One standalone full-body character only.
